name: quiz-nest
description: Online examination platform that keeps working when the internet doesn't.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @quiz-nest/api
